checks.evidence: Level 1 test only checks that the LOA speed timer starts when the first balise is passed. It never checks that the time-out elapses or that the LOA speed is set to zero.
Level 2 test only checks that the timer starts at the message timestamp. It never checks time-out expiry or the speed being set to zero.

invented: Assumption that the OBU clock is synchronized with trackside time is written as an assumption, so it is not counted as invented.
